evidence_direction_note: diagnostic: routes a build/route decision on MECH465-COMMIT-GATE-HEADROOM, never claim credit for MECH-465

trend.statistic: mean over scorable seeds of the per-seed ln-gain per budget doubling (least-squares slope of ln DV on log2 budget over WARM200/400/800)

criteria.name: C2_pooled_trend_plateau_below_bar
criteria.detail: pooled ln-gain per doubling 0.117, CI95 [0.037, 0.183]; plateau iff CI upper < ln(1.15)

criteria.name: C2b_pooled_trend_climbing_below_bar
criteria.detail: climbing iff CI lower > 0 and point >= ln(1.15)

criteria.name: C3_phased_p0b_is_independent_lever
criteria.detail: seeds with |ln(PHASED/WARM400)| >= ln(1.25) AND bootstrap CI excluding 0: 2/3 measured

criteria.name: C4_p1_readable_under_recalibration
criteria.detail: count of green sweep cells with all 6 urgency levels' commit rate in [0.05, 0.95]; P2-gated by arithmetic: graded only once IQR/median is comparable to the grid's +/-13% bracket around the median

combination_rule: outcome = PASS iff C1. C2/C2b/C3/C4 never change the outcome: on a C1 FAIL the label is chosen in this order -- any single-seed clear -> seed_split_partial_clear; C2 (plateau with confidence) -> route exhausted; C2b (climbing with confidence) -> extend budget; else trend indeterminate. C3/C4 are recorded readouts.

interpretation.what_a_null_does_not_mean: A plateau below the bar says the gate-rescale ROUTE is exhausted on this gated quantity with the encoder trained; it is not evidence against MECH-465's assertion, which remains untested (its DV is still saturated). A PASS says a headroom regime exists; it is not evidence FOR MECH-465 either -- the residual-DV experiment has not run.

dv_headroom.name: rv_iqr_over_med_ladder_range
dv_headroom.description: The DV's reachable range under the manipulation IS this run's question, so no headroom precondition gates it (a dv_headroom_check on the COLD control, ~0.03 vs 0.51, would self-route every run to substrate_not_ready_requeue). The ladder is the headroom measurement: achievable_by_cell is each arm's max DV over green seeds; C2's plateau test is the falsifier of the ceiling.

custom_information.magnitude_correction: The 2026-08-27 'P2 fails by 11-19x' figure was measured on an untrained z_world and is overstated ~3-4x; the confound-free shortfall at WARM200 is 2.7-5.8x (mech465_zworld_warmup_dispersion_spike_20260904.md).
custom_information.per_arm_recalibration: threshold := post-warmup median of the free-running rv (never-commit sentinel), per cell; the spike measured every arm at the COLD-calibrated thresholds, under which the warm arms never committed (P1 unreadable).

z_goal_stream_note: agents step through sense/select only; no update_z_goal call by design
